name: How long does it take to repair or replace a door threshold?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair or replace a door threshold?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration for threshold repair or replacement depends on the scope of the project. A simple repair, such as filling minor cracks or re-sealing, might only take a few hours. A more extensive repair involving rot removal and section replacement could take a full day. A complete threshold replacement, especially if custom fitting or significant subfloor work is required, might extend to one to two days. We prioritize efficient and quality work to minimize disruption to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple threshold repairs can take a few hours, while extensive repairs or full replacements might take one to two days depending on complexity.
